job.job_description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Agentic GenAI Engineer to join AI Center of Excellence (AICOE) and drive the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered agentic systems. This role focuses on building intelligent automation solutions leveraging Anthropic models, Google ADK, and modern GenAI frameworks on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will play a key role in translating business requirements into scalable AI solutions, developing multi-agent workflows, and optimizing LLM-based applications for enterprise use cases.

Required Technical Skills

Programming Languages
Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML and backend development
Cloud Technologies
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as:
Vertex AI
Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
BigQuery / Cloud Storage
IAM security best practices
GenAI / Agentic Frameworks
Experience working with Anthropic (Claude models) APIs
Practical experience in building agentic workflows using Google ADK
Strong understanding of LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and multi-agent architectures
Working knowledge of LangChain for building LLM-powered pipelines and applications
Databases / Vector Stores
Hands-on experience with at least one:
Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma)
Traditional databases (SQL/NoSQL)
Experience implementing RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines
Core AI/ML Skills
LLM fine-tuning / prompt optimization strategies
Evaluation and monitoring of GenAI applications
API integration and microservices architecture

Required Experience

89 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML, or related domains
At least 3+ years of hands-on experience in GenAI / LLM-based application development
Proven experience building and deploying production-grade AI systems on GCP
Demonstrated expertise in designing agentic workflows and autonomous AI systems
Strong problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and solution design capabilities

Mandatory Competencies

Data AI - GEN AI - Workflow Agentic Frameworks (LangChain / LangGraph)
Data AI - GEN AI - AI Search Index
Data AI - GEN AI - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) / Graph RAG / Agentic AI Systems
Data AI - GEN AI - Advanced GenAI Agentic Framework Concepts
Data AI - GEN AI - Fine-tuning Model Customization / AI Agents Tool Calling
Data AI - GEN AI - Cloud Application Integration Deployment
Data AI - GEN AI - Python
Data AI - GEN AI - Prompt Engineering / Vector Databases
Data AI - GEN AI - Pandas
Data AI - GEN AI - NumPy
Beh - Communication and collaboration
